title: fix(plugin-list): Display reset compares hidden fields and density with the view's own (objectui#12949)
body:
Fixes #12949
Clause-②: yes

## What changed

On a console list, after a user hid a column (or changed the density) and reloaded, the Display control's "Reset to view default" was disabled and its trigger counted nothing. Since objectui#12474 the console lays the user's stored `hiddenFields` / `rowHeight` over the view's in `schema`, and `ListView` compared the user's list against `schema`, that is, against the user's own choice.

- `@object-ui/plugin-list` (`ListView`): a new optional host prop, `viewDefaults?`, typed as `Pick` of `ListViewSchema` over the two keys `hiddenFields` and `rowHeight` (spelled out in words because GitHub strips angle-bracket generics from a body), carries the VIEW'S OWN values. `displayDeviation.hiddenFields` and `displayDeviation.density` (grid density; the gallery card size is unchanged) compare against it, so the trigger count follows, and `resetDisplayToViewDefault` writes it through the controls' own doors (`updateHiddenFields` and so `onHiddenFieldsChange`; `density.setMode` and so `schema.onDensityChange`), so the user's preference follows, as Show all does. When the prop is passed its members are the whole baseline (absent `hiddenFields` = the view hides nothing; absent `rowHeight` = the default density). Without it, `schema` is the view's own, exactly as before.
- The objectui#12423 docblock above `displayDeviation` is rewritten: it no longer says the console persists density and hidden fields back into the view.
- `@object-ui/app-shell` (`ObjectView`): computes `viewRowHeight` and `viewHiddenFields` (the view's values before the overlay) and passes them as `viewDefaults`. On a view that declares no `columns` the view's authored `hiddenFields` is never applied (objectui#10694, objectui#12505), so `viewHiddenFields` is `undefined` there: the view hides nothing, and the reset returns to every drawn column. The `hiddenFields` rung reads the new local; the `rowHeight` rung keeps its inline `normalizeListViewSchema` fold, because the relay census (`ObjectView.relayRungCensus-7559.test.ts`) reads that rung's text for the retired `densityMode` alias.

## Mechanism readings (dispatch section 2)

- **A1, the seam.** `ListViewSchema` gains nothing (it mirrors the spec). The narrowest seam is one optional member on the exported `ListViewProps`, beside the existing host props `defaultRowNumbers` and `toolbarLeading`. No existing prop could carry it: `initialFilters` / `initialSearchTerm` carry the user's state, and the `{ [key: string]: any }` rest on the destructure is untyped, which AGENTS.md commandment 0.1 rules out. So **Clause-②: yes (widening)**, and the changeset levels `@object-ui/plugin-list` at `minor` (`@object-ui/app-shell` `patch`; its exports do not change).
- **A2, other hosts.** Only `app-shell`'s `ObjectView` relays a preference: `git grep` for `onHiddenFieldsChange` / `onDensityChange` / `listPrefs` over `packages/*/src` and `apps/*/src` (tests excluded) finds it alone. The other `ListView` hosts (`InterfaceListPage`, `ObjectDataPage`, `StudioDesignSurface`, `plugin-view`'s `ObjectView`, `ListViewBlock`, the console's SDUI workbench preview) pass no `viewDefaults` and keep comparing against `schema`, which is pinned as a control below.
- **A3, the pins** are listed under Tests.

## Tests (at `388e1f9059`)

- New `packages/plugin-list/src/__tests__/ListView.displayResetBaseline-12949.test.tsx` (7 tests): (a) a user hidden set that differs from `viewDefaults.hiddenFields`: on mount the reset is ENABLED and the count reads 1; pressing it calls `onHiddenFieldsChange` once with the view's set and the count goes; an absent `viewDefaults.hiddenFields` is the empty set; (b) the same for density (`rowHeight: 'compact'` over the view's `'tall'`: the reset writes `'spacious'` through `schema.onDensityChange`); both differing count 2; (c) CONTROL: a preference equal to the view's leaves the reset disabled and nothing counted; (d) CONTROL: no `viewDefaults`: `schema` is the baseline, as before.
- `packages/app-shell/src/views/ObjectView.userListState-12418.test.tsx`, new describe (4 tests, pin 6c in its header): after a reload `schema` carries the user's choice and `viewDefaults` the view's own; writing `viewDefaults` back through the two doors lands as one save of the user's row with no view write; another user is handed the same value twice; on an unprojected saved view `viewDefaults.hiddenFields` is `undefined`.
- Runs (each under the shared verify lock, `--maxWorkers=1`): the plugin-list families naming `displayDeviation` / `display-reset-button` / `resetDisplayToViewDefault` / `viewPref` / `hiddenFields` / `viewDefaults`: `Test Files 4 passed (4)`, `Tests 185 passed (185)`; the app-shell families on the same terms: `Test Files 15 passed (15)`, `Tests 162 passed (162)`. The first app-shell run went red on the relay census (`densityMode`'s fold must stay spelled out on the `rowHeight` rung); the second commit restores the inline fold, and the rerun above is green.
- `type-check` for `@object-ui/plugin-list` and `@object-ui/app-shell` (after `turbo run build --filter='@object-ui/app-shell^...'`): exit 0. Both packages' `tsconfig.test.json` include `src/**/*.test.tsx`, so the new tests are type-checked.
- **Ablation, run once.** `ablation-replace.mjs` swapped `sortedNames(viewDefaultHiddenFields)` back to `sortedNames(schema.hiddenFields)` (anchor 1 to 0, blob `f33d106eda74` to `41e98e996bcd`); the new plugin-list file went `Tests 3 failed | 4 passed (7)` (the hidden-field pins went red; density and controls stayed green, as expected). Restored: blob after restore = HEAD blob `f33d106eda74`, `git diff HEAD` empty.
- Declared to CI: the full `packages/plugin-list/` and `packages/app-shell/` directories (not run locally, per the dispatch's lock rule).
